purpose: Prospectively test whether a new ETH option-readiness event followed by a strict one-sided false sweep predicts a 30-minute reversal in ETH linear futures after realistic costs and latency.

discovery_boundary.btc_definition_role: economic_inspiration_only; no BTC observation, effect, sample, threshold result or cutoff is ETH evidence

event_quality: no collector outage or reconnect interval crossing the feature/outcome window
both exchange health histories meet the declared 80-percent five-minute bucket rule
causal same-contract Greek match ratio >= 0.80 for each used exchange
matched surface gap <= 600 seconds and overlap >= 0.95 when a surface comparison is used
complete ETHUSDT one-minute outcome path coverage >= 0.95

false_sweep_definition.upper: At least one one-minute candle in the final 15 minutes has high > preceding rolling 15-minute high * 1.001 and closes below that prior high.
false_sweep_definition.lower: At least one one-minute candle in the final 15 minutes has low < preceding rolling 15-minute low * 0.999 and closes above that prior low.
false_sweep_definition.both_or_none: Reject BOTH and NONE; exactly one side is required.

ohlcv_definition.entry_rule: first complete one-minute candle close at or after the event timestamp plus the declared execution delay
ohlcv_definition.exit_rule: the complete one-minute candle close 1800 seconds after entry

walk_forward.thresholds: fixed in this preregistration; no post-freeze retuning
walk_forward.outcomes: non_overlapping within each declared model and day/week blocks

multiple_testing_family.members: ETH-H8 primary reversal at delays 0/15/60 seconds; continuation, price-only and neutral controls are reported at the same timestamps; costs are execution stress, not additional selections
multiple_testing_family.reported_p_values: unadjusted descriptive values are allowed only with explicit small-sample labeling; promotion uses adjusted familywise values

confirmation_gate.failure_policy: NOT_READY, REJECTED_CURRENT_SAMPLE or TECHNICALLY_BLOCKED; never retune from confirmation results

anti_leakage: Only ETH data strictly after eligible_data_after_utc can enter confirmation.
All event features end at or before the event timestamp.
Greek joins use the latest earlier snapshot of the same ETH contract on the same exchange with age <= 600 seconds.
Matched surfaces use the same contract IDs only, gap <= 600 seconds and overlap >= 0.95.
Outage and reconnect intervals are excluded and are never repaired by interpolation.
Outcomes are complete one-minute paths and non-overlapping.
BTC and SOL observations, thresholds, results and sample sizes can never enter ETH confirmation.
The freeze timestamp is immutable; a failed gate does not move it backward.
